text: FAA guidance says if the control link cannot be reestablished, emergency procedures for loss of control link should be started. It requires regaining VLOS as soon as practicable and the remote PIC to land, hover, or initiate RTH. M30T manual: RC loss >6 seconds triggers Failsafe RTH; Advanced RTH with good lighting/vision, Original Route RTH when not; ATTI with auto-landing is possible. Unverified incident reports describe lost link with RTH within seconds, back-to-back losses, antenna interference, unresponsive RTH, and subsequent manual landing. Gaps: lack of explicit thresholds, no step-by-step post-loss actions, and no model-specific failure cases; open questions about RTH vs ATTI triggers and obstacle avoidance reliability.
